brief: Make the creator portal a cheat code: if using us makes a video obviously better and obviously easier, creators market us for free.
test: Could somebody open this, hit record within two minutes, and sound like the most informed voice in the hobby without pausing to look anything up? Every pause is a cut.

findings.observation: 10 distinct angles are ready each morning.
findings.why: This one is solved. A creator's worst hour is the one spent deciding what to make.
findings.fix: Hold it. The risk now is the opposite — too many choices is its own paralysis, so lead with three and let the rest be a list.

findings.why: Enough for a thumbnail, an insert and a closing frame.
findings.fix: The gap is that they are files in a repo. A creator needs them one tap from the angle they picked, not from a folder.

findings.observation: Artist angles all carry their sources.
findings.why: This is the part that makes a creator trust us twice — the second time is what matters.
findings.fix: Extend the same to every angle in the post bank, and put the source in the script so it can be said aloud.

findings.observation: The pieces exist and are reachable, but a creator still assembles them: pick an angle here, find the card there, open the overlay separately.
findings.why: The cheat code is not having good assets. It is not having to think. The moment somebody has to hunt for a matching image, they are editing instead of recording.
findings.fix: ONE screen per angle: the subject, the spoken open, the numbers as a lower-third, the card ready to download, the source line, and a record checklist. Pick an angle, hit record.

findings.observation: Nothing tells a creator how a piece performed after they made it.
findings.why: Creators repeat what works. If we never close that loop they learn nothing from us and we learn nothing from them, which is the difference between a tool and a partner.
findings.fix: Ask one question after publication — did this land — and keep the answers. Even a yes/no on twenty videos would tell us which angles are worth generating.
